records.rule: The Rasen Falcon rehearsal joins native LDAP listener, NoSQL restart recovery, STARTTLS/LDAPS and Access Permissions; missing real dependencies produce NOT_RUN rather than substitution.
Human, CHATGPT and CLAUDE are distinct principals; rights are not inherited across principals unless explicitly granted.
Service admission checks principal ACTIVE state before authorised action; a revoked principal fails closed.
LDAP authentication is not a signature and neither authentication nor signature alone grants EMAIL_SEND.
Private website admission consumes LDAP identity plus explicit HTTPS_LOGIN authority; public site publication is a separate authority.
Production LDAP is NOT_INSTALLED; owned Deployment service remains installation/activation authority.
Exact dev22 ZIP standards scan: 82 files, 0 errors, 136 warnings, PASS; fresh r13196 runtime rehearsal remains NOT_RUN.
